notes: Seed http://www.co.cooke.tx.us/page/cooke.elections works over https; files are hosted on newtools.cira.state.tx.us (CIRA) and www.co.cooke.tx.us. No Clarity or vendor site; page links SOS results. Last-Modified values differ per file and look like real upload times. Each 2026 election has an Early Voting unofficial file, one election-night precinct-by-precinct unofficial file, and later official files. 2024 general undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both END (check 2: one election-night precinct report with election-day votes), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT. Confidence med because each has a printed run time and a server upload time on election night.

2024_general.fact: The Elections page now lists only 2025 and 2026 elections; no 2024 general results file is posted. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Final Unofficial Results Precinct by Precinct' is a 187-page Electionware 'Pct. by Pct. Results UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 2026 Primary Election March 3, 2026 Cooke County, Texas Pct. 1 ...' with Absentee, Early Voting and Election Day columns; footers print '03/03/2026 10:12 PM'. Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 03:37:31 GMT (9:37 PM CST), PDF CreationDate 04:13:31 UTC; the 35-minute gap between printed and upload times suggests a clock offset, but both fall on election night. The precinct 'Ballots Cast - Total' values sum to 8,055, equal to the 'Final Unofficial Results' summary (printed 03/04/2026 10:15 AM), so this was the final unofficial count. Only one precinct file is listed.

2026_runoff.fact: '2026MayCookePrimaryRunoffUnofficialResultsPctbyPct.pdf' is a 34-page Electionware 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 2026 Primary Runoff Election May 26, 2026 Cooke County, Texas Pct. 1 ...' per-precinct report, footers '05/26/2026 8:48 PM', PDF CreationDate 2026-05-27 01:49:29 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 03:46:37 GMT (10:46 PM CDT). Only one precinct file is listed; it was not cross-checked against the final summary.
